value: files.* (and to a lesser extent context.*, arch.*) get used as scratch space, not seeds. Pattern: agent writes a key, refines it, writes again — same key codex_set 4-7× per session. Worst observed: files.font_awesome_content_view rewritten 7× in session 4fc5ce9a; files.icon_search_view 6× in 8b648fbf. This is the mechanism behind the ~10:1 write:read skew on files.* (123 writes / 9 reads in 16 sessions). Each rewrite is mostly identical content with small deltas — pure noise from the store's perspective. Cheap detection: track lastWriteAt per key per session in audit; flag when same key is set ≥3× within one session. Disciplined stores (kh734385/CAS_robot, m02 audit) cap at 2× and have a balanced write:read ratio. The pattern is not store-specific; it's agent-discipline-specific. Pairs with arch.lint and ccli stale.
